title: Uncomfortable, hard, parts don't fit together properly. I gave it the dogs as a bed.
text:
Uncomfortable, hard, parts don't fit together properly. I gave it the dogs as a bed.. Ok, at this price point, you really should not have any expectations of anything beyond the bottom of the barrel in quality. That's exactly what you'll be getting by the way. Where do I start? The fabric - it's a linen type weave that's pretty stiff and harsh against any skin. You're not going to be snuggled up on this seat without a thick throw between you and the fabric. Then there's the lack of stuffing which makes sitting here like sitting on a layer of foam over a rock.

Putting it together is relatively simple until you get the part where you zipper the fold out cushions to the base. That zipper is a total failure. It doesn't work and I can't force it to work so my two fold out cushions are just acting as the seat. Even if they zipped together and folded out correctly, the entire set up is flimsy and seriously uncomfortable. I would pay for a hotel room for my guests before I ever considered making them sleep on this.

The only reason I'm giving this two stars is because I'm able to repurpose it as a big dog bed. Sort of a mini sofa just for my dogs. They aren't thrilled with it, but they are including it in the dog bed rotation.
